title: Backyard Cricket Commentary (Chas McIvor)
style: rockabilly two step jangle electric guitar slap back echo walking bass brushed drums hiccup vocal fast beat 132bpm comedy dad voice spoken interjections fifties pop swing three voice commentary
lyrics:
[Intro - Bluey calling]
Good afternoon and welcome to Eversley Street
The sun is out, the esky is open
Chas McIvor is at the crease
And his son is bowling

[Verse 1 - Chas batting]
Son, I have faced bigger bowlers than you
I was playing backyard cricket when you were in a nappy
Now bowl it properly and stop aiming at my shins

[Bluey]
AND HE BOWLS, SHORT AND WIDE, CHAS IS LINING UP THE CUT SHOT

[Trevor]
Technically the delivery was four centimetres outside off stump
Ideal conditions for the square cut

[Chorus]
Commentary from the backyard, Bluey on the call
Trevor with the numbers, Chas against the wall
Dad is at the crease, son is running in
Backyard cricket commentary, let it begin

[Verse 2 - Chas coaching mid-point]
Now son, when you bowl short, back your length
Do not give a batter room to move
Bowl fuller, six to eight metres out
That is where the wickets come about

[Bluey]
CHAS IS COACHING THE BOWLER WHILE BATTING
ONLY IN BACKYARD CRICKET

[Trevor]
Statistically, batters who coach their opponents mid-point
Win seventy-three percent of those deliveries

[Bridge]
Chas: I say son, the secret to this game
Is that your old man taught both sides equally well
You learned from me
So whatever you bowl, I already know what is coming

Bluey: THAT IS THE MOST CONFIDENT THING EVER SAID IN BACKYARD CRICKET
Trevor: I have no data to refute that claim

[Final Chorus]
Commentary from the backyard, Bluey on the call
Trevor with the numbers, Chas against the wall
Dad is at the crease, son is running in
Backyard cricket commentary, let it begin

[Outro - Chas]
And that son
Is how you commentate backyard cricket
Now go get the ball from Mrs Hendersons garden
Thats my boy
